Melee weapons only. Each Attack Action can move you to an enemy within your Move Distance, Strike it, then Escape automatically with no free Attack against you. A kill from one of these Strikes grants +1 Attack Action (max 3).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.42
system.summary: Melee weapons only. Each Attack Action can move you to an enemy within your Move Distance, Strike it, then Escape automatically with no free Attack against you. A kill from one of these Strikes grants +1 Attack Action (max 3).

automation.note: Each Attack Action: move up to your Move Distance to an enemy, Strike it with a melee weapon, then Escape it automatically with no free Attack against you. Each kill from these Strikes grants +1 Attack Action (max 3); track the extras by hand.
